parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for reporting this. We understand that after the most recent release, your analytics dashboard now takes about 30–45 seconds to load instead of under 5 seconds, which is slowing daily planning for your operations team (though the page does eventually load).

To help us narrow down what changed and improve performance, could you share the following?
1) The dashboard URL (or dashboard name) and the user role/workflow you’re using when you see the slow load.
2) Approximate time of day/timezone when you tested (and whether it’s consistent for all users).
3) Any error messages or browser console/network errors you see during the slow load.
4) If possible, a HAR file or a few screenshots showing the load timing (e.g., total page load time / key API calls).

Once we have that, we’ll review the regression signals around the last release and work with engineering to determine the next best steps to improve dashboard responsiveness.
